title: Vanilla Plastic
description: This resource pack adds textures to Minecraft like in the Minecraft trailer.
body:
This mod is currently updating from version 1.3.0, updating 276 textures, if you have any problems, then write in the reviews, it is specially for this mod, it supports Minecraft versions 1.21-1.21.1, newer versions will be posted in the versions tab, no textures were taken from other resource packs or texture packs, the author recommends downloading the latest version of the modpack for your desired Minecraft version




The resource pack updates 276 textures in Minecraft. They become minimalistic and, like in Minecraft trailers, each texture is verified by the author. The textures have a format of 32x32 pixels.
